title: Resultants, Recursive Formulas and Binet Formulas for $\textrm{SU}(N)$ Verlinde Sums
summary: We study Verlinde sums $V_{n}(N,m)$, which for our purposes are finite sums of trigonometric functions $\{r_{x}\}$, associated to $\textrm{ SU}(N)$. In this article we prove the following results: (i) the polynomial $D_N(w):=\prod_x(w-r_x)$ is equal to, up to an explicit and computable factor, the iterated resultant of $Q(u)=u^m-1$ with an explicit elementary polynomial $W_N$ which is independent of $n$ and $m$; (ii) for fixed $N$ and $m$, $V_n(N,m)$ satisfies a linear recursion of order at most $\binom{m-1}{N-1}$, together with arguments showing that one actually has a recursion of length…
